subject: Marketplace partner: joint discovery & scheduling
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eloise Martin <eloise@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:23:00-08:00
Subject: Marketplace partner discovery — recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking the call today, Eloise — good conversation and lots to do here. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: Run a joint technical deep-dive to validate integration points for CloudBridge marketplace listing and confirm performance/latency targets for a pilot.
- Key stakeholders to include: your marketplace/product lead, procurement (Samir), and CloudOps/network. From Redwood: Ben (AE), Camila (SE), Vivek (Partner).
- Scope for the deep-dive: network requirements, model onboarding workflow, how billing/marketplace entitlements map to our Dedicated/Hosted options, and a short demo of the integration flow.

Proposed meeting length: 45–60 minutes. Here are a few slots that work for our team next week (all PT):
- Thu 2026-12-03 09:00–10:00
- Fri 2026-12-04 13:00–14:00
- Tue 2026-12-08 11:00–12:00

If none of those fit, drop a couple of options and I’ll align calendars. I also attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP_v1.pdf) that lays out milestones for a pilot and typical owner roles — feel free to edit.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/marketplace-demo

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (mutual action plan, 1 page)]

From: Eloise Martin <eloise@cloudbridge.com>

Date: 2026-12-01T17:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace partner discovery — recap & next steps

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear recap. Thu 12/03 09:00 PT works for me and I’ve added Samir from procurement to the thread. Our marketplace ops person (cc’d via marketplace@cloudbridge.com) will circulate an MS Teams link and a short pre-read this afternoon.

Quick asks before the deep-dive:
- Could your SE (Camila) share a short checklist of technical prerequisites (network ranges, certificate requirements, common firewall rules)?
- We’ll want to see how entitlements map to pricing tiers in the demo — is there a short mock flow you can show?

If we need to push to Friday I’ll flag it, but Thu looks good.

Eloise
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudBridge
[mailto:eloise@cloudbridge.com]
